disclaimer: Prototype/demo regulatory catalogue for YHACK '26. Not a complete or legally binding list of government requirements.

requirements.name: GST Registration
requirements.description: Demo requirement for GST registration when supplying goods or services.

requirements.name: Business Registration
requirements.description: Demo company incorporation / CIN related registration.

requirements.name: Pollution Consent
requirements.description: Demo Consent to Establish / Operate style environmental clearance for manufacturing units.

requirements.name: Factory Licence
requirements.authority: Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health, Tamil Nadu
requirements.description: Demo factory licence for manufacturing premises. Often sequenced after environmental consent in this prototype.

requirements.name: Fire Safety NOC
requirements.authority: Tamil Nadu Fire and Rescue Services
requirements.description: Demo fire safety NOC for factory / commercial premises.

requirements.name: Trade Licence
requirements.description: Demo local trade licence. Applicability depends on local body rules.

requirements.name: Labour Registration
requirements.description: Demo labour / shop-and-establishment style registration when employee count crosses the prototype threshold.

requirements.name: Professional Tax Registration
requirements.description: Demo professional tax registration for employers in Tamil Nadu.

requirements.name: FSSAI License
requirements.authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
requirements.description: Demo FSSAI licensing for food manufacturing. Confirm category (registration vs licence) on the official portal.

requirements.name: Udyam Registration
requirements.authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
requirements.description: Demo MSME / Udyam registration for eligible manufacturing units.

requirements.name: ESI Registration
requirements.description: Demo ESIC coverage when employee threshold in this prototype is met.

requirements.name: Final Operational Clearance
requirements.description: Demo downstream operational clearance. In this prototype it depends on Factory Licence.
